instruction: A still mangrove swamp: arching stilt roots rising from tea-colored water, hanging moss and vines, a weathered flat-bottom boat with a lantern, herons stalking the shallows, lily pads and reeds, a rickety plank walkway, drifting mist, dragonflies, and shafts of green light breaking through the dense canopy.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Mangrove Swamp Waterway. A still mangrove swamp: arching stilt roots rising from tea-colored water, hanging moss and vines, a weathered flat-bottom boat with a lantern, herons stalking the shallows, lily pads and reeds, a rickety plank walkway, drifting mist, dragonflies, and shafts of green light breaking through the dense canopy. Style: humid atmospheric. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
